post.summary: Authorize a reporting conversation and access its CRM case
post.description: Server-to-server only; requires REPORTING_API_TOKEN and CRM. Start returns tool definitions and a one-hour session token. No profile or context until the spoken code loads a profile; case selection requires caller confirmation and ownership. No provider calls, dispatch or messaging. Only start/end are generally idempotent; retain channel IDs and deduplicate model tool calls in the caller backend. Locally implemented; deployment not verified. Separate interface from caller-context: load_crew_profile still accepts arguments.spoken_code, not name/authorization. Local source only; not included in the caller-context deployment.

post.summary: Load a demo profile by name and fictional authorization phrase
post.description: Server-to-server only. The bearer token authenticates Michael’s service. Name and authorization must match the same demo CRM record; this is not real identity proof. Replaces the spoken_phrase request field; existing name-prefixed demo hashes remain supported. Uses CONTEXT_API_TOKEN, JSON POST, and a private 15-minute in-memory session lost on restart; tokens are not interchangeable with /api/reporting sessions. No OpenAI or Twilio requests. Successful responses include top-level crew_member_id (crew_members.id), stable for the authorized session and directly usable by POST /api/decisions.

post.summary: Choose a reporting action using authorized CRM context
post.description: Accepts a trusted reporting backend crew_member_id and free-text context blob under REPORTING_API_TOKEN; caller authentication belongs to the reporter, with no caller session or phrase check on this intake. Rejects the intentionally nonexistent USS Nebraska with 404 crew_member_not_found and reason ship_not_found before storing a blob or calling Decisions. Other valid blobs are appended to private CRM before classification and assembled with caller-owned history. Returns respond, gather_context, or route_to_expert with full context; never calls MCP. Existing {session_token, request} requests remain supported. DECISIONS_ENABLED=false still saves accepted blobs but makes no provider request. Live requests require separate authorization; deployment of migration 006_reporter_context.sql is required for the new intake.

404.description: Unknown crew_member_id, nonexistent assigned ship, or service token not configured. The nonexistent USS Nebraska response includes reason ship_not_found.

Disabled voice returns 404. A successful TwiML response does not prove connected audio or a completed callback; later media admission can open an OpenAI Live connection. No live invocation is authorized by this contract.

get.summary: Upgrade a signed Twilio media WebSocket
get.description: WebSocket upgrade only. Voice flag, signature, capacity and a bound one-use start ticket are required. Connection/start frames precede media; a valid start may open billable OpenAI Live traffic. HTTP inventory does not validate the WebSocket message protocol.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted; start ticket still required

post.summary: Record a signed SMS delivery callback
post.description: Available even when SMS sending is disabled. Validates exact URL/form signature, account, stored message and provider SID. Preserves first terminal outcome and retains later observations; makes no outbound provider request.

204.description: Observation recorded; does not imply delivered unless callback said delivered

400.description: Duplicate form key or unknown status

name.description: Full CRM display name; case-insensitive with whitespace normalized. Must match the same record as the authorization phrase.

authorization.description: Spoken fictional authorization phrase, without the caller name.

profile.description: Safe CRM profile. Contains no phone numbers, contact records or authorization hashes.

crew_member_id.description: The authenticated demo record primary key, crew_members.id. Returned only after successful name/phrase authorization; send unchanged as crew_member_id to POST /api/decisions.

profile.description: Allowlisted CRM profile; no contact numbers or authorization hashes.

SharedCRMContext.description: Same safe context supplied to Live, Decisions and the persisted specialist assignment. Working queue status alone is not proof an expert has started.

StoredSolution.description: Caller-confirmed case finding or current specialist result; rejected or obsolete results cannot be reused as a fix.

state.description: queued means the handoff was persisted, not expert execution.

crm_context.description: Shared context; crm_context and context are identical aliases. Version 2 for trusted reporter intake, version 1 for legacy sessions.

context.description: Shared context; crm_context and context are identical aliases. Version 2 for trusted reporter intake, version 1 for legacy sessions.

context_id.description: Receipt for a saved reporter blob, including failed/disabled classification; null on the legacy session path.

issue.description: Raw classifier choice: case ID, new:<equipment UUID>, new:unassigned, or unclear; null on the legacy path. An expert route above 0.50 can create a general case despite an unclear or low-confidence match; context.selected_case identifies the actual case.

ReportingAction.description: respond includes solution; gather_context instructs a caller question and explicit reclassification; route_to_expert includes desk, task_id, dispatch_key, dispatch_policy and tool_call. Null for an undecided result or an unavailable handoff. This is a proposal, never a record of MCP execution.

dispatch_key.description: Same task_id; reporting backend must durably claim/reconcile it. Not an MCP idempotency guarantee.

context.description: JSON-serialized original safe CRM handoff snapshot; reused tasks preserve it unchanged.

ExpertToolCatalog.description: Repository declarations, not a live tools/list observation. The reporting backend confirms actual availability.

LegacyDecisionRequest.description: Compatibility path using the authorized reporting session and selected case.

crew_member_id.description: Caller identity already authenticated by the reporting backend; must exist in CRM.

context.description: Nonblank, well-formed free text without NUL; stored verbatim in private CRM. Limit is JavaScript UTF-16 string length. No truncation or automatic retry.

text.description: Complete saved reporter text projection with phone-like numbers withheld; CRM retains the verbatim original.

ReporterCase.description: Complete caller-owned case facts, eligible stored solution, task history, parts, message statuses and timeline summaries. Private contact/provider identifiers are excluded.

ReporterCRMContext.description: Complete caller-scoped context. No five-case or ten-task preview cap. Large contexts fail classification explicitly instead of silently dropping records.

profile.description: Full caller profile, equipment, preferences and case references, excluding authentication/contact secrets.

queue.description: All current-revision, non-obsolete tasks for this caller’s cases.

history.description: Caller interaction metadata without provider identifiers.
